title: Metal-Refining Furnace Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend furnaces, such as gas, oil, coal, electric-arc or electric induction, open-hearth, or oxygen furnaces, to melt and refine metal before casting or to produce specified types of steel.

tasks.text: Regulate supplies of fuel and air, or control flow of electric current and water coolant to heat furnaces and adjust temperatures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual gas flow control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate gas flow.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.
Adjust flow of electricity to tools or production equipment.

tasks.text: Draw smelted metal samples from furnaces or kettles for analysis, and calculate types and amounts of materials needed to ensure that materials meet specifications.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.
Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Weigh materials to be charged into furnaces, using scales.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Record production data, and maintain production logs.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Observe air and temperature gauges or metal color and fluidity, and turn fuel valves or adjust controls to maintain required temperatures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate gas flow.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Operate controls to move or discharge metal workpieces from furnaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect furnaces and equipment to locate defects and wear.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.

tasks.text: Drain, transfer, or remove molten metal from furnaces, and place it into molds, using hoists, pumps, or ladles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement of materials into molds

dwas.name: Place materials into molds.

tasks.text: Kindle fires, and shovel fuel and other materials into furnaces or onto conveyors by hand, with hoists, or by directing crane operators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical ignition of heating equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Ignite fuel to activate heating equipment.
Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Prepare material to load into furnaces, including cleaning, crushing, or applying chemicals, by using crushing machines, shovels, rakes, or sprayers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual cleaning of materials for production

dwas.name: Clean materials to prepare them for production.

tasks.text: Remove impurities from the surface of molten metal, using strainers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Skimming molten metal, hazardous manual task

dwas.name: Skim impurities from molten metal.

tasks.text: Observe operations inside furnaces, using television screens, to ensure that problems do not occur.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Sprinkle chemicals over molten metal to bring impurities to the surface.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Skimming molten metal, hazardous manual task

dwas.name: Skim impurities from molten metal.

tasks.text: Direct work crews in the cleaning and repair of furnace walls and flooring.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Scrape accumulations of metal oxides from floors, molds, and crucibles, and sift and store them for reclamation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
